description: JavaScript implementation of the SHA-1 cryptographic hash function, including functions for computing SHA-1 hashes, HMACs, and encoding conversions.

methods.name: hex_sha1
methods.description: Computes SHA-1 hash of a string and returns hex-encoded string.

methods.name: b64_sha1
methods.description: Computes SHA-1 hash of a string and returns base64-encoded string.

methods.name: any_sha1
methods.description: Computes SHA-1 hash of a string and encodes in arbitrary encoding.

methods.name: hex_hmac_sha1
methods.description: Computes HMAC-SHA1 with a key and data, returns hex string.

methods.name: b64_hmac_sha1
methods.description: Computes HMAC-SHA1 with a key and data, returns base64 string.

methods.name: any_hmac_sha1
methods.description: Computes HMAC-SHA1 with a key and data, encodes in arbitrary encoding.

methods.name: sha1_vm_test
methods.description: Performs a self-test to verify SHA-1 implementation correctness.

methods.name: rstr_sha1
methods.description: Calculates SHA-1 hash of a raw string.

methods.name: rstr_hmac_sha1
methods.description: Calculates HMAC-SHA1 of a key and data (raw strings).

methods.name: rstr2hex
methods.description: Converts raw string to hex string.

methods.name: rstr2b64
methods.description: Converts raw string to base64 string.

methods.name: rstr2any
methods.description: Converts raw string to an arbitrary encoding.

methods.name: str2rstr_utf8
methods.description: Encodes a string as UTF-8.

methods.name: rstr2utf16le
methods.description: Encodes a string as UTF-16 little endian.

methods.name: rstr2utf16be
methods.description: Encodes a string as UTF-16 big endian.

methods.name: rstr2binb
methods.description: Converts raw string to array of big-endian words.

methods.name: binb2rstr
methods.description: Converts array of big-endian words to string.

methods.name: binb_sha1
methods.description: Calculates SHA-1 of array of big-endian words and length.

methods.name: sha1_ft
methods.description: SHA-1 auxiliary function for current iteration.

methods.name: sha1_kt
methods.description: SHA-1 constant for current iteration.

methods.name: safe_add
methods.description: Adds two 32-bit integers with wraparound.

methods.name: bit_rol
methods.description: Bitwise rotate left a 32-bit number.
